text.EN: He's down... let's just get out of here.
text.TL: Bagsak na siya... umalis na tayo rito.

text.EN: Please... can we just leave this place?
text.TL: Pakiusap... pwede bang lumayo na tayo rito?

text.EN: Don't search him. Let's just go.
text.TL: Huwag mo na siyang kapkapan. Umalis na lang tayo.

text.EN: I don't want to be here anymore.
He's dead. We need to leave before others show up.
text.TL: Patay na siya. Kailangan nating umalis bago may dumating pang iba.

text.EN: Let's grab what we need and run.
text.TL: Kuhanin ang kailangan at tumakbo na tayo.

text.EN: I can't stay near his body. Come on.
text.TL: Hindi ko kayang tumayo malapit sa bangkay niya. Halika na.

text.EN: He's dead... let's just move away.
text.TL: Patay na siya... lumayo na tayo.

text.EN: Get me out of here. Please.
It's done. Don't look back. Walk.
text.TL: Tapos na. Huwag kang lilingon. Lakad.
